title: Isolation of Cell Fractionation
author: Mengchen Shi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kcfcstn

steps.title: Prepare and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Collect 5 × 10^6 cells via brief trypsinization and resuspend the pellet in mitochondria extraction buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 200 µl of mitochondria extraction buffer containing 0.02 mM phenylmethanesulfonyl fluoride (PMSF) and proteinase inhibitors (Keygentec, Nanjing, China).

steps.title: Homogenize Cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the cell suspension on ice and homogenize the cells.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize using a glass Dounce and pestle.

steps.title: Fractionate Cell Components
steps.instruction: Perform sequential centrifugation to separate cytoplasmic proteins from mitochondria.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge homogenates at 600 g for 15 min at 4℃.
Collect the resulting supernatant and centrifuge it at 11,000 g for 15 min at 4℃.
Identify the supernatant as cytoplasmic proteins and the pellet as mitochondria.

steps.title: Lyse Mitochondrial Pellet
steps.instruction: Lyse the isolated mitochondria pellet using mitochondria extraction buffer.
